title: encelia cordata
intro: Encelia cordata, commonly known as the heart-leaf encelia, is a shrubby perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Encelia cordata include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throats, and skin irritations, due to its therapeutic actions of soothing and calming the body.
